title: Explicit delivery receipt fallback
description: When ack:true is set and recipient does not reply within receipt window (RECOMMENDED 5 minutes), recipient node sends standalone receipt POST to sender /msg/ack with {id, status:delivered, ts}. Start timer on message receipt, cancel if any reply to that sender is sent (which carries ack_through). Explicit receipts are themselves custody-transfer messages. Spec: 12-apps.md §18.1.2 explicit receipt. All three impls. Depends on: ack_through (ldhl.10), custody chain (ldhl.6).
